Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent to burn or reckless disregard of an obvious fire risk); inadvertently forgetting the stove is mere negligence and supplies no malice.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is only the two alternating phases diastole and systole; contraction, relaxation, and rest are not additional named phases.

Q8294.reason: Hydrogen bonds hold ice in an open crystalline lattice less dense than liquid water, so pressure favors the denser liquid and the solid-liquid line slopes negatively.
